newsitem.title: USA: Battle Mountain sees meeting 1997 targets.
newsitem.headline: Battle Mountain sees meeting 1997 targets.

text.p: Battle Mountain Gold Co said on Wednesday that while its first quarter results had been "below plan," the company still expects to meet its production targets for the year.
"Battle Mountain Gold is in business to create shareholder wealth by producing more than 900,000 ounces of gold in 1997," said BMG president and chief executive Ian Bayer.
Attributable gold production for the first quarter was approximately 200,000 ounces, compared with about 246,000 ounces in the same period of last year, the company said.
BMG posted a first quarter consolidated net loss of $9.1 million, or four cents per share, compared with net income of $3.1 million, or one cent per share, in the same period last year.
The mining company attributed the net income loss primarily to lower gold prices and production, and to a final merger-related expense of $2.2 million.
